deadlines.name: Persistent Sample Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on representative samples of similar machine-based information resources, at least once per day.
deadlines.label: 1 day

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Changes in Foreign Interest
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST report updated information relating to any foreign interest, foreign influence, or foreign control of the independent assessment service within 48 hours of any change in foreign ownership or control.
deadlines.label: 48 hours

deadlines.name: Evaluate Vulnerabilities Quickly
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications SHOULD evaluate ALL vulnerabilities as required by VER-EVA (Evaluation) within 2 days of detection.
deadlines.label: 2 days

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP 20x Class C offerings MUST verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every 3 days.
deadlines.label: 3 days

deadlines.name: Persistent Sample Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on representative samples of similar machine-based information resources, at least once every 3 days.
deadlines.label: 3 days

deadlines.name: Evaluate Vulnerabilities Quickly
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications SHOULD evaluate ALL vulnerabilities as required by VER-EVA (Evaluation) within 5 days of detection.
deadlines.label: 5 days

deadlines.name: Agency Access Denial
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify FedRAMP within 5 business days of denying an agency access request for FedRAMP Certification Data.
deadlines.label: 5 business days

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class D Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every week.
deadlines.label: 1 week

deadlines.name: Notification After Finishing
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties within 5 business days after finishing transformative changes, including updates to all previously sent information.
deadlines.label: 5 business days

deadlines.name: Notification After Verification
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties within 5 business days after completing the verification, assessment, and/or validation of transformative changes, also including the following information:
deadlines.label: 5 business days

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP 20x Class B offerings MUST verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every 7 days.
deadlines.label: 7 days

deadlines.name: Persistent Drift Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are likely to drift, at least once every 7 days.
deadlines.label: 7 days

deadlines.name: Persistent Sample Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on representative samples of similar machine-based information resources, at least once every 7 days.
deadlines.label: 7 days

deadlines.name: Evaluate Vulnerabilities Quickly
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD evaluate ALL vulnerabilities as required by VER-EVA (Evaluation) within 7 days of detection.
deadlines.label: 7 days

deadlines.name: Historical Activity
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications SHOULD make all recent historical vulnerability detection and response activity available in JSON format for automated retrieval by all necessary parties (e.g. using an API service or similar); this information SHOULD be updated persistently, at least once every 7 days.
deadlines.label: 7 days

deadlines.name: Public Notice of Emergency Tests
deadlines.statement: FedRAMP MUST post a public notice at least 10 business days in advance of sending an Emergency Test message; such notices MUST include explanation of the likely expected actions and timeframes for the Emergency Test message.
deadlines.label: 10 business days

deadlines.name: FedRAMP Certification Reports
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST include FedRAMP Certification Reports with their FedRAMP Certification Data without inappropriate modifications, and make such reports available within 2 weeks of receiving the materials from FedRAMP.
deadlines.label: 2 weeks

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class C Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every 2 weeks.
deadlines.label: 2 weeks

deadlines.name: Notification Requirements
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties within 10 business days after finishing adaptive changes, also including the following information:
deadlines.label: 10 business days

deadlines.name: Notification of Final Plans
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties of final plans for transformative changes at least 10 business days before starting transformative changes, including updates to all previously sent information.
deadlines.label: 10 business days

deadlines.name: Persistent Drift Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are likely to drift, at least once every 14 days.
deadlines.label: 14 days

deadlines.name: Persistent Sample Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on representative samples of similar machine-based information resources, at least once every 14 days.
deadlines.label: 14 days

deadlines.name: Evaluate Vulnerabilities Quickly
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications SHOULD evaluate ALL vulnerabilities as required by VER-EVA (Evaluation) within 14 days of detection.
deadlines.label: 14 days

deadlines.name: Historical Activity
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications SHOULD make all recent historical vulnerability detection and response activity available in JSON format for automated retrieval by all necessary parties (e.g. using an API service or similar); this information SHOULD be updated persistently, at least once every 14 days.
deadlines.label: 14 days

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class B Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP Rev5 Class B offerings SHOULD verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP Rev5 Class C offerings MUST verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP Rev5 Class D offerings MUST verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistent Machine Verification and Validation for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers of FedRAMP 20x Class A offerings SHOULD verify and validate the status of machine-based information resources at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistently Complete Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are NOT likely to drift, at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistently Complete Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are NOT likely to drift, at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Persistent Drift Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are likely to drift, at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Monthly Activity Report
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST report vulnerability detection and response activity to all necessary parties in a consistent format that is human readable at least monthly.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Historical Activity
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications MAY make all recent historical vulnerability detection and response activity available in JSON format for automated retrieval by all necessary parties (e.g. using an API service or similar); this information MAY be updated persistently, at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Historical Activity
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD make all recent historical vulnerability detection and response activity available in JSON format for automated retrieval by all necessary parties (e.g. using an API service or similar); this information SHOULD be updated persistently, at least once every month.
deadlines.label: 1 month

deadlines.name: Notification of Initial Plans
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties of initial plans for transformative changes at least 30 business days before starting transformative changes, including a summary of any likely security impacts or changes in risk.
deadlines.label: 30 business days

deadlines.name: Update Documentation
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST publish updated service documentation and other materials to reflect transformative changes within 30 business days after finishing transformative changes.
deadlines.label: 30 business days

deadlines.name: Quarterly Review Meeting
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications MAY host a synchronous Quarterly Review every 3 months, open to all necessary parties, to review aspects of the most recent Ongoing Certification Reports that the provider determines are of the most relevance to agencies.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Quarterly Review Meeting
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD host a synchronous Quarterly Review every 3 months, open to all necessary parties, to review aspects of the most recent Ongoing Certification Reports that the provider determines are of the most relevance to agencies.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Quarterly Review Meeting
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications MUST host a synchronous Quarterly Review every 3 months, open to all necessary parties, to review aspects of the most recent Ongoing Certification Reports that the provider determines are of the most relevance to agencies.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Quarterly Review Meeting
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications MUST host a synchronous Quarterly Review every 3 months, open to all necessary parties, to review aspects of the most recent Ongoing Certification Reports that the provider determines are of the most relevance to agencies.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class A Certifications SHOULD persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Fresh Independent Assessment
deadlines.statement: Providers seeking Class A Certification MAY supply a fresh initial FedRAMP independent assessment that was completed by a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service within the previous 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Fresh Independent Assessment
deadlines.statement: Providers seeking Class B Certification MUST supply a fresh initial FedRAMP independent assessment that was completed by a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service within the previous 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Fresh Independent Assessment
deadlines.statement: Providers seeking Class C Certification MUST supply a fresh initial FedRAMP independent assessment that was completed by a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service within the previous 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Fresh Independent Assessment
deadlines.statement: Providers seeking Class D Certification MUST supply a fresh initial FedRAMP independent assessment that was completed by a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service within the previous 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Persistent Drift Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are likely to drift, at least once every 3 months.
deadlines.label: 3 months

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class D Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every six months.
deadlines.label: 6 months

deadlines.name: Persistently Complete Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are NOT likely to drift, at least once every 6 months.
deadlines.label: 6 months

deadlines.name: Persistently Complete Detection
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications SHOULD persistently perform vulnerability detection on all information resources that are NOT likely to drift, at least once every 6 months.
deadlines.label: 6 months

deadlines.name: Mark Accepted Vulnerabilities
deadlines.statement: Providers MUST categorize any vulnerability that is not or will not be fully mitigated or remediated within 192 days of evaluation as an accepted vulnerability.
deadlines.label: 192 days

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class B Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Certification Package Maintenance for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class C Certifications MUST persistently maintain their FedRAMP Certification Package to ensure it is up to date and complete at least once every year.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class B Certifications MUST include the following Rev5 Controls in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year:
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class C Certifications MUST include the following Rev5 Controls in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year:
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for Rev5
deadlines.statement: Providers with Rev5 Class D Certifications MUST include the following Rev5 Controls in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year:
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: FedRAMP Independent Assessments
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class A Certifications MAY persistently complete an independent verification and validation assessment of all applicable FedRAMP rules with a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service OR FedRAMP at least once per year; this is a FedRAMP independent assessment.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: FedRAMP Independent Assessments
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class B Certifications MUST persistently complete an independent verification and validation assessment of all applicable FedRAMP rules with a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service OR FedRAMP at least once per year; this is a FedRAMP independent assessment.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: FedRAMP Independent Assessments
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class C Certifications MUST persistently complete an independent verification and validation assessment of all applicable FedRAMP rules with a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service OR FedRAMP at least once per year; this is a FedRAMP independent assessment.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: FedRAMP Independent Assessments
deadlines.statement: Providers with Class D Certifications MUST persistently complete an independent verification and validation assessment of all applicable FedRAMP rules with a FedRAMP Recognized independent assessment service OR FedRAMP at least once per year; this is a FedRAMP independent assessment.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class B Certifications MUST include all Key Security Indicators in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class C Certifications MUST include all Key Security Indicators in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.name: Annual Independent Assessments for 20x
deadlines.statement: Providers with 20x Class D Certifications MUST include all Key Security Indicators in a FedRAMP independent assessment at least once per year.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Annual Foreign Interest Reports
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST report information relating to any foreign interest, foreign influence, or foreign control of the independent assessment service to FedRAMP annually.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Annual Surveillance Assessment
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST achieve a favorable annual surveillance assessment by the American Association for Laboratory Accreditation (A2LA) to maintain FedRAMP Recognition.
deadlines.label: 1 year

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Actually Do Assessments
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST complete at least 2 initial or ongoing assessments for Class B, C, or D FedRAMP Certifications every 2 years to maintain FedRAMP Recognition.
deadlines.label: 2 years

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Full A2LA Reassessment
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST achieve a favorable full reassessment by the American Association for Laboratory Accreditation (A2LA) at least once every 2 years to maintain FedRAMP Recognition.
deadlines.label: 2 years

deadlines.documentName: FedRAMP Recognition of Independent Assessment Services
deadlines.name: Advisory Separation
deadlines.statement: Assessors MUST NOT perform a FedRAMP independent assessment of the same cloud service offering within 2 years after supplying advisory or consulting services for that offering, unless FedRAMP publishes a specific exception for a limited pilot or other explicitly scoped process.
deadlines.label: 2 years
